        String s = in.nextLine();
        int insert = 0;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < s.length()) {
            char current = s.charAt(i);
            int j = i;
            while (j < s.length() && s.charAt(j) == current) {
                j++;
            }
            int count = j - i;
            if (count % 2 == 0) {
                insert++;
            }
            i = j;
        }
        System.out.println(insert);
    }
